decisions.reason: Reframing the Page 47 photograph does not change the background treatment required for the specified special pages.
The Page 47 photograph is unrelated to the one-page cover letter, signature insertion, or handling of the cover letter's overflow photos.
The source requests a localized photograph-framing adjustment and does not change the full-document layout approach, coverage, or spacing.
The photograph-framing request does not affect font type, font size, or unresolved bolding treatment.
Revealing more of a tree in the Page 47 photograph does not alter the Blue Mesa brand identity or required brand elements.
The Page 47 photograph adjustment does not affect inclusion or placement of the organization chart.
The visual adjustment does not change Canva editing access, file ownership, or the free-assets policy.
Reframing a photograph has no logically entailed effect on the requirement that final-file hyperlinks remain functional.
The source does not change the supplied tables, budget sheet, replacement count, or approved table source.
The Page 47 framing adjustment does not change the maximum page count or the spacing policy used to approach it.
The photograph request does not affect the biography count, affiliation, source, or population method.
The localized photograph-framing change neither alters required section content nor resolves whether Section 11 belongs in the proposal.
